fusions.name: Basker's Ambush
fusions.desc: Takes 1 second of stillness, then spits a cold jet that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets. It is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Chill Spit
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. Spits cold water at a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 7 damage, hitting harder the further it travels, up to 1.5 times at full reach, with a 30% chance to leave it [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Shed and Regrow
fusions.desc: Restores 16 health to you. Its healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

fusions.name: Riverbank Sunning
fusions.desc: During the day, your damage rises by 10%. You carry 8% water resistance.
